findings.title: First-visit hint toast is drawn on top of the summary panel
findings.detail: Opening the summary on a first visit shows the touch hint toast in the middle of the screen, over the summary panel. On phone it covers the 'Downed most by...', 'Hit most by...' and 'Picked...' lines, so the summary can't be read until the toast fades. Also on watch-summary@land, where it covers '1. The Regent Hollis' (the first fight row).
findings.evidence: contrast.md: summary phone panel text under the toast measures p10 1.11 to 1.98. DOM: toast text box [121,507,148,58]; toast panel about [98,497,194,78]; summary rows in the same band.
findings.fix: Don't show the touch hint while the summary is open (or dismiss it when Summary is pressed), and never draw a toast over a panel the viewer just opened.

findings.title: Summary panel runs under the control bar and its last sections are hidden
findings.detail: The summary panel is taller than the space above the control bar and does not scroll into view: on desktop the 'Notes' heading (y 1027) and the note text (y 1068) sit behind the bar that starts at y about 972, so the notes, the panel's way to jump to a moment, can't be seen. On watch-summary@phone 'Light Step' is cut at y about 587; on watch-summary@land only the title and two fights fit (panel visible y about 52 to 240).
findings.evidence: DOM watch-summary@desktop: 'Notes' at [1561,1027,...], note text at y 1068; control bar top about y 972 in the screenshot.
findings.fix: Cap the panel height at the space between the header and the control bar and make it scroll, or move the summary into its own full-height sheet on phone and land.

findings.title: Arming delete shifts the row and puts 'Delete for good?' where the star was
findings.detail: When Delete is armed the wider 'Delete for good?' button pushes the row's other columns left. On phone the star moves from x 263 to 197 and the confirm button [243,352,127,44] now covers the place the star occupied (263 to 307), so a second tap aimed at the star deletes the run. On list-delete@desktop the columns jump too: names 884 to 849, Fight 1248 to 1183, length 1349 to 1284.
findings.evidence: DOM list@phone star [263,352,44,44] vs list-delete@phone star at x 197 and confirm [243,352,127,44]; desktop column x values above.
findings.fix: Reserve the confirm button's width in the row (or open the confirm in place of the Delete button without moving its neighbours) so nothing else moves when delete is armed.

findings.title: Star and Delete touch the row link and each other
findings.detail: The row link, the star and Delete are adjacent targets with 0 to 2 px between them, below the 8 px gap. Phone: link 20 to 263, star 263 to 307 (0 gap), Delete 309 to 370 (2 px). Desktop list@desktop: link ends at 1387, star at 1393 (6 px), Delete at 1439 (2 px after the star ends at 1437). Same on list-delete.
findings.evidence: DOM list@phone and list@desktop control boxes.
findings.fix: Keep at least 8 px between the link, the star and Delete (e.g. a gap on the action cluster and padding on the link's right edge).

findings.title: Transport and camera buttons are 6 px apart; land timeline is under 44 px
findings.detail: On phone the transport row (Play 13 to 57, Back 63 to 107, ...) and the camera row below it (row 641 to 685, next row from 691) leave 6 px between targets, under the 8 px minimum. Same layout on every watch-* phone and land shot. On land the timeline (fight numbers '1 2 3 4') is 810x38, under the 44 px touch height.
findings.evidence: DOM watch-follow@phone controls; contrast.md 'small target' list: land timeline 810x38.
findings.fix: Use an 8 px gap between the bar's buttons and make the timeline's hit area at least 44 px tall on touch layouts.

findings.title: Viewer controls sit inside the phone's safe-area insets
findings.detail: Phone: the header controls start at y 10 (back [12,10,64,44], Summary [279,10,99,44]) and the title at y 20, inside the 47 px top inset; the bottom camera row (Maren/Free from [13,789,...]) ends at y 833, 11 px from the bottom, inside the 34 px home-bar inset. Land (watch-follow@land): the bottom row ends at y 379 of 390. Desktop: controls are 12 to 13 px from the edges against a target of about 58 px. Same on every watch-* screen.
findings.evidence: DOM watch-follow@phone header and camera-row boxes.
findings.fix: Pad the header and control bar with env(safe-area-inset-*) plus a margin (at least 47 px top / 34 px bottom on a notched phone, about 3% of width on desktop).

findings.title: Hint toast covers the centre of the scene on land
findings.detail: On land the 'Tap a player to follow them...' toast lands in the centre box (x 338 to 506, y 156 to 234), over the players being watched.
findings.evidence: watch-follow@land screenshot; toast panel about [212,169,421,59].
findings.fix: Anchor the toast to an edge (top under the header, or just above the control bar) so the middle of the scene stays clear.

findings.title: Timeline fight numbers are 11 px
findings.detail: The fight numbers along the timeline are 11 px, below the 12 px floor for any label. Same on every watch-* screen at every viewport.
findings.evidence: DOM watch-follow@desktop: fight numbers at [21,986,4,15] and [594,986,6,15], size 11.
findings.fix: Set the timeline numbers to at least 12 px (14 px on phone), bold, with tabular figures.

findings.title: Timeline fight numbers are 2.46:1
findings.detail: The timeline numbers are grey (170,164,147) on the bar's grey (96,98,99), 2.46:1 against the 4.5:1 minimum. Same on every watch-* screen.
findings.evidence: contrast.md: timeline fight numbers, declared contrast 2.46.
findings.fix: Use the panel's light text colour for the numbers, or darken the track behind them, to reach 4.5:1.

findings.title: Header text over the 3D scene has no backing plate
findings.detail: The header's small texts sit straight on the scene, so their contrast changes with what is behind them. 'Copy link' on watch-damaged@desktop measures p50 3.34, p10 1.92; 'v7.090.0' on watch-old@desktop [444,23,47,16] p50 2.36, p10 1.49; 'Cut short' and 'Damaged' on watch-cut@phone and watch-damaged@phone p10 3.26 to 3.56.
findings.evidence: contrast.md rows for 'Copy link' (watch-damaged), 'v7.090.0' (watch-old) and the phone state tags.
findings.fix: Give the header a solid or strongly darkened strip (or a plate behind each tag) so every header text holds 4.5:1 at p10.

findings.title: An older-version run is marked only by a bare version number
findings.detail: The only sign that this run comes from an older game version is the 12 px 'v7.090.0' tag. Nothing says the run is from an older version, that the missing boss plays as a stand-in, or why the boss bar is absent, so a viewer reads the differences as bugs. Same on watch-old@phone.
findings.evidence: watch-old@desktop screenshot and DOM: 'v7.090.0' [444,23,47,16]; no boss bar in the scene.
findings.fix: Replace the bare number with plain words, e.g. 'Recorded in v7.090: some bosses play as stand-ins', shown once near the header.

findings.title: One coral colour means live, damaged, danger and death
findings.detail: The same coral carries four meanings: 'Live now' on the list (243,178,162), the 'Live' tag (240,154,134, class rv-live), the 'Damaged' tag on watch-damaged (same rv-live class), the armed 'Delete for good?' fill on list-delete (236,154,135), plus the down rings and death squares on the timeline. A viewer can't tell from colour whether a run is live or broken.
findings.evidence: DOM: 'Live' [437,23,22,16] class rv-live on watch-live@desktop; 'Damaged' tag with the same class on watch-damaged@desktop; list and list-delete colours above.
findings.fix: Keep coral for danger and deaths only; give 'Live' its own colour (e.g. a green or the accent with a dot) and 'Damaged' a neutral warning style.

findings.title: Translucent summary panel lets game name tags and HUD show through
findings.detail: The summary panel is see-through, so the game's HUD (boss name, 'Fight 2 0:25') and the player name tags show behind the panel's text. On phone 'Maren the Bold' and 'Marc' sit around '0:50 · fell' ([310,340,59,20]; Marc tag p10 2.35). Also on watch-summary@land and watch-cut@phone; on watch-summary@desktop the 'Ser Quill' tag at [1714,411] ghosts into the panel.
findings.evidence: watch-summary@phone screenshot and contrast.md entry for the summary panel rows.
findings.fix: Make the panel background opaque (or at least 90% with a blur) so nothing from the scene or game HUD reads through it.

findings.title: The game's menu splash collides with the replay controls at the end
findings.detail: At the end of a run the game's main-menu splash ('Boss Rush / Fight 4: Giant Skeleton / Best played with a controller') appears behind the replay UI. On desktop 'Best played with a controller' runs into the timeline (3.18:1); on watch-end@phone it shows through the camera row at y 767 (1.25:1). It reads as the game, not the replay, and the replay's own end state is lost under it.
findings.evidence: DOM watch-end@desktop: 'Best played with a controller' [869,987,222,15]; contrast.md 3.18 desktop, 1.25 phone.
findings.fix: Suppress the game's menu splash in the replay viewer and show the replay's own end state (e.g. the summary or 'Watch again').

findings.title: Gold means both 'selected camera' and 'primary action'
findings.detail: Gold fill marks the selected camera (Aleix) and the primary action (Pin, Watch again), so on watch-note two gold buttons compete for the eye; same on watch-cut. On watch-summary gold marks the player-name headings (not clickable) and the note time (clickable), while the clickable fight rows use the same grey (170,164,147) as non-interactive text.
findings.evidence: DOM watch-note@desktop: Pin [1056,901,64,46] gold next to the gold selected camera button.
findings.fix: Show the selected camera with an outline or underline and keep gold fill for the one primary action; give clickable rows a distinct affordance.

findings.title: Note box is narrow on phone and opens over the key-hint toast
findings.detail: On phone the note input is 181 px wide, so the start of the text is scrolled out of view ('s through the roll here') and the hint toast ghosts behind it. On watch-note@desktop the note box opens over the key-hint toast, which still peeks out ('free camera ·' to the right of Cancel).
findings.evidence: DOM watch-note@phone: input [25,517,181,46].
findings.fix: Hide the hint toast while the note box is open and let the input span the panel width on phone.

findings.title: Day headings, labels and footer are 13 px mixed case
findings.detail: The Player/When labels, the day headings and the footer are 13 px non-uppercase text, under the 14 px floor; on list@phone the body text and headings are 13 px too, under the phone's 14 px body minimum. Also on list-delete and list-empty.
findings.evidence: DOM list@desktop: 'Today' [420,139,35,17] size 13; footer [420,858,328,17] size 13.
findings.fix: Set body text, headings and the footer to 14 px or more; keep 12 px only for short uppercase labels.

findings.title: Header state tags are 12 px mixed case
findings.detail: 'Live', 'Cut short', 'Damaged' and 'v7.090.0' are 12 px in mixed case; 12 px is allowed only for short uppercase labels. On watch-live, watch-cut, watch-damaged and watch-old at every viewport.
findings.evidence: DOM watch-live@desktop: 'Live' [437,23,22,16] size 12, not uppercase.
findings.fix: Either set the tags in uppercase with tracking at 12 px or raise them to 14 px.

findings.title: Nine text sizes in the summary panel; three within 2 px on the list
findings.detail: The viewer's summary uses 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 19, 20 and 26 px; the list uses 13, 14, 15, 19 and 40 px, with 13/14/15 too close to read as separate levels.
findings.evidence: DOM watch-summary@desktop and list@desktop text sizes.
findings.fix: Collapse to a short scale (e.g. 12 uppercase label / 14 body / 18 heading / 26 title) and map every text to one step.

findings.title: Key-hint toast repeats the labels of the visible buttons
findings.detail: The desktop key-hint toast lists 'N next death', 'M note', 'F free camera' while buttons named Next death, Note and Free are on screen. Same on every desktop watch-* screen.
findings.evidence: DOM watch-follow@desktop: toast [665,893,590,66].
findings.fix: Show the shortcut key on the buttons themselves (a small key cap or in the tooltip) and drop the toast.

findings.title: 'Cut short' and the way back are each shown twice
findings.detail: 'Cut short' is both the header tag [425,23,53,16] and the panel title 'Cut short at fight 2'; the panel's 'All replays' button [1705,282,104,56] duplicates the header's 'Replays' back link [12,10,100,44].
findings.evidence: DOM watch-cut@desktop.
findings.fix: Drop the header tag when the panel says it, and keep one way back (the panel button or the header link, not both).

findings.title: 'Free' doesn't say what it frees
findings.detail: The camera row button is labelled just 'Free', while the hint toast calls it 'free camera'. Next to player names it reads like a status, not a camera mode. Same on every watch-* screen.
findings.evidence: watch-follow@phone camera row from [13,789,...]; hint toast text 'free camera'.
findings.fix: Label it 'Free camera' (or a camera icon with that accessible name).
